feeders.measured_note: Saskatchewan oil pipelines report movements in Petrinex volumetrics, so these flows are measured receipts (REC, crude oil) into each pipeline system by month. Capacity data is not public, so this is throughput, not utilization against a nameplate.
feeders.ab_note: Alberta feeder pipelines are licensed in the Petrinex facility directory but report no movements in public volumetrics, so no monthly flow series can be built for them from this dataset. They are listed for coverage; Saskatchewan measured systems are the flow sample.
